jobs.description:
Company Activities:

Our client operates at the forefront of the aluminium window and door industry, offering bespoke solutions for both residential and commercial markets. Their subsidiary, specializing in high-end aluminium constructions, has earned a reputation for precision engineering and innovative designs. With a focus on sustainable practices and cutting-edge technology, they aim to set new benchmarks in the industry.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a prominent leader in high-quality aluminium window and door solutions, is seeking a Technical Assembler to join their growing team near Eeklo. Specializing in both residential and commercial projects, they are known for their commitment to precision and innovation. If you have a keen eye for detail and experience in complex finishing processes, this opportunity is for you!

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Play a pivotal role in the assembly and finishing of new types of aluminium sliding frames, doors, and folding walls, ensuring the highest standards of precision and quality	
• Interpret technical drawings to align the finishing process with project requirements and client specifications	
• Report directly to the Production Manager, ensuring seamless communication and workflow.

Profile Description:
	
• A solid technical background	
• Affinity for complex products and a strong motivation to excel in a specialized role	
• Experience or interest in aluminium constructions	
• Your strengths include technical insight and a meticulous approach to work	
• Language Requirement: Proficiency in Dutch or English is mandatory.

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. The culture of the company is more informal but in a professional way, open and supportive, offering you both professional growth and the chance to contribute to meaningful projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)
• Coordinate schedules and resources for internal programmes and training sessions
• Assist with reporting, data checks and preparing presentations for management
• Support HR processes such as onboarding administration and training follow-up
• Handle administrative follow-up for suppliers and internal approvals
• Ensure accurate documentation, filing and archiving (digital and hard copy)
• Take on ad hoc administrative tasks that keep the office and operations running smoothly

• 2+ years of experience in administration, coordination or office support
• Organised, detail-oriented and flexible in handling different priorities
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• A strong communicator in English, Dutch (and French)
• Proactive, service-minded and a natural team player
• Diploma in administration, business or similar is a plus but not required

Join a well-established international financial institution with a strong presence across EMEA. Known for its expertise in corporate banking, financial services, and global markets, the company offers a collaborative environment where innovation, operational excellence, and long-term client relationships are at the heart of its success.

Jobomschrijving

• Process and monitor domestic and international payments.
• Manage incoming client requests and internal inquiries via email and phone.
• Support administrative follow-up of banking operations and client files.
• Assist with Trade Finance and Guarantee-related transactions.
• Maintain and update client documentation and e-banking agreements.
• Perform reconciliations, operational controls, and account maintenance tasks.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and KYC requirements.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency projects.
• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset (french big plus)
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.
• Strong communication skills and a client-focused mindset.
• Previous experience in administration, operations, banking support, or financial services is a plus.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:
	
• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.	
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.	
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.	
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.	
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).	
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.	
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.	
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.	
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:
	
• High school diploma or associate’s degree.	
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.	
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.	
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.	
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.	
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.	
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.	
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields—and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing—we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:
	
• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.	
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.	
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.	
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.	
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:
	
• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.	
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.	
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.	
• Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.	
• Able to provide good references.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;	
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;	
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;	
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Our client is an international company headquartered in the Antwerpen region with over 30 years of experience at the international scale. They are looking for an IT Project Manager acting as a primary stakeholder in project coordination (applications and infrastructure) as well as technologies related to SAP within the company.

Jobomschrijving

The IT Project Manager is a key stakeholder in project coordination concerning all IT-related matters within the company. This individual will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external support partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role requires a business-focused expert who can advocate for user needs and take the necessary actions for planning and support.

Key responsibilities:

Business System Support:

• 

Act as a super-user and system expert for SAP (ERP), specifically for the S4Hana and Coupa modules (with 80% of the projects being finance-related).
• Understand the architecture and process flows of ERP, Process Control, and related manufacturing systems
• Monitor system health and stability.
• Troubleshoot and address system issues, outages, and functional needs, engaging support partners as needed
• Support business users as a subject matter expert on existing and proposed system functionality
• Act as program manager and project stakeholder for system upgrades and enhancements

End User Support:

• Act as the first responder for user desktop issues (hardware and software), engaging the help desk and support partners as needed.
• Facilitate requests for purchases.
• Observe and anticipate user needs, and make appropriate recommendations for improvement.

Infrastructure, Process and Policy:

• Assist users in understanding IT Policy, Process, and Systems.
• Support business leadership in strategic planning and project oversight.
• Coordinate site activities for upgrades and system maintenance.
• Make recommendations for enhancements that will improve system function, capabilities, and stability.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or engineering field.
• Proven ability to work across functional and regional boundaries, challenge status quo, and handle multiple projects simultaneously while delivering on time and on budget.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and change management skills.
• 3-8 years' experience in IT role in a global company.
• Mixed skills should include configuration and expertise in SAP Coupa and S4Hana.

Our client is a well-established and dynamic company located in Brussels. They offer a stimulating work environment where professionals can grow, develop new skills, and build a long-term career. Due to continued expansion, they are looking for a motivated Administrative Assistant to join their team.

Jobomschrijving

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting daily office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
• Preparing and formatting documents, reports, and presentations
• Supporting various departments with administrative tasks
• Handling agendas, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments
• Ensuring proper filing and data management
• Assisting with internal communication and basic logistics
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient functioning of the office

• You are graduated in Administration, Office Management, Languages, Business, or equivalent
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Organized, detail-oriented, and eager to take initiative
• Communicative, proactive, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment
• Motivated to kickstart your career in administration and open to learning on the job

Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of iconic brands and an established presence in the Belgian retail market.

Jobomschrijving

• Take full ownership of the commercial portfolio.
• Develop and maintain strong strategic customer relationships and act as the key commercial point of contact.
• Lead customer negotiations, Joint Business Plans, contracts and commercial agreements.
• Drive sales growth by identifying new business opportunities and developing customer-specific initiatives.
• Support the Channel Manager in defining sales strategies, commercial targets and promotional policies.
• Develop sales volume budgets and forecasts for assigned customers.
• Monitor customer spending, contractual agreements and commercial investments against budget

• Master's degree in Economics, Marketing, Business or equivalent experience.
• 5-10 years of experience in Sales, Trade Marketing or Key Account Management.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian retail/FMCG market.
• Excellent negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, business planning and claim management.
• Autonomous and comfortable taking full ownership of customer relationships.
• Strong presentation and communication skills.
• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is required.
• Fluent in French and English.

As Technical Lead in the night shift, you will be the team lead of all technical profiles (8 people) in this shift in order to maximize production output while ensuring compliance with defined quality standards. You will coordinate and coach all technical profiles and manages the escalations. More specifically, you will:
 
 
 
• Ensure that equipment performance meets targets and minimize manufacturing failures. 
 
• Support in technical issues on the shop-floor and managing the escalation flow. 
 
• Develop and coach technical personnel to reach higher team results. 
 
• Be responsible for the administration of the personnel in the shift - holidays, sick leaves, transportation, competency review, etc. 
 
• Lead and coordinate escalations with other departments to resolve technical issues promptly. 
 
• Distribute the technical tasks among technical personnel in the shift, setting up team priorities, and making follow-ups on the progress during the shift. 
 
• Participate in improvement projects. Support the recruitment of technical personnel if needed. 
 
• Support / lead the local certification process (depending if there is a training department on site or not). 

Your profile
 
 
 
• Relevant Bachelor degree or Technician with around 5 years of relevant experience.  
 
• Good knowledge of technical coaching principles. 
 
• Excellent communication, team collaboration and targeted mentoring skills. 
 
• Good knowledge of MS office/Google.  
 
• Good understanding of English. 
 
• Ability to use all necessary job-related tools and make precise manual adjustments. 
 
• Analytical, logical, and interpretive mindset for complex technical data. 
 
• Proven ability to lead and coordinate technical activities on a shift or zone level.

Would you like to join an international company on a human scale in Brussels and gain valuable professional experience? We are looking for a versatile Travel & Customer Care Assistant to support the DiscoverEU team in delivering smooth travel coordination and high-quality participant support. Key Responsibilities Travel & Customer Care
 
 
 
• Respond promptly to participant enquiries via email and chat, ensuring agreed service levels are met 
 
• Coordinate travel logistics, including booking support, document verification, and expense/invoice tracking 
 
• Identify and escalate complex cases to the appropriate team members when required 
 
• Manage special travel situations (e.g. accessibility needs, lost tickets, rebookings) and maintain accurate records 
 
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, data protection rules, and financial guidelines 
 
• Support administrative tasks and team coordination as needed 
 
• Troubleshoot participant documentation issues and follow escalation processes 
 

 Admin, IT & Tools
 
 
 
• Use internal platforms and helpdesk tools to efficiently assist participants 
 
• Work with databases, IT systems, and standard office tools 
 
• Ensure all data handling complies with GDPR and internal IT security protocols 
 
• Promote sustainability principles as part of EMAS commitments 

 
 
•   
 
• Available between June and August (with extension until September–October for German and/or Polish speakers) 
 
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken) 
 
• Good written skills in German, Dutch, and/or Polish (German and Polish are strong assets) 
 
• Strong customer service mindset and professional communication skills 
 
• Well-organised, able to manage priorities and meet deadlines 
 
• Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality, accuracy, and consistency 
 
•

jobs.description:
What you will be working on

The YUFE Alliance is looking for a motivated Communications and Monitoring Officer that will have the opportunity to:

• Take part in the daily operations of the YUFE Central Office in Brussels
• Manage and maintain the website, including content development, monitoring and contact with web developers
• Coordinate the implementation of the YUFE seed funding, including communication and dissemination, support to applicants, selection process and committee, as well as follow-up and iteration of the scheme
• Keep up to date the contact database and distribution lists for YUFE communications
• Support market analysis on our joint educational offers 
• Support our communications content planning, delivery, monitoring and reporting
• Assist in the planning and execution of meetings and events
• Assist in project management tasks such as reporting and dissemination 
What we are looking for

We are looking for a dedicated, proactive team player that wants to contribute to a dynamic team within an international and intercultural environment. As equity, diversity and inclusivity belong to YUFE's core values, we are searching for a colleague fully committed to these principles.

• Ideal start date: January 2027
• You hold a master's degree
• At least 3 years of working experience in a Communications/Dissemination based role or similar
• Good knowledge of MS Office package (experience with SharePoint and Exact Online), Mailchimp, Canva, WordPress, experience with CornerStone is an asset
• You are strong at planning and organisation 
• You have excellent written and oral communication skills in English (any other European language will be an asset)
• You feel at ease to work independently, within a small team and are flexible to support a diverse range of tasks 
What we are offering 

• A contract of indefinite duration (under Belgian law)
• Salary based on experience (and orientated on salary scales of Belgian Universities)
• Competitive package of benefits (meal vouchers, full reimbursement of public transport, group insurance, etc.) 
• An open working environment with attention to your work-life balance and up to 40 days of holidays
• The possibility of working from home two days a week 
• Broadening of your professional networks in Brussels and across the EU

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

STRATEGY & CEO SUPPORT

¿ Support key decisions with analyses and business cases
¿ Turn priorities into action plans and drive them across departments
¿ Lead cross-functional projects and external partners
¿ Spot growth and efficiency opportunities

RETAIL EXPANSION

¿ Identify and analyze locations for new ateliers
¿ Build business cases on sales potential, investment and returns
¿ Manage real-estate agents, landlords and partners
¿ Run the process from screening to investment decision and budgeting

STRATEGIC & OPERATIONAL PROJECTS

¿ Lead operational improvement projects with production
¿ Support new channels and partnerships, from delivery platforms to a franchise model
¿ Renegotiate supplier contracts and support strategic procurement

PROCESS OPTIMIZATION, AI & AUTOMATION

¿ Find inefficient processes and help teams automate them
¿ Use AI and digital tools to sharpen analyses and productivity
¿ Build practical AI use cases across departments with IT

GROWTH & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

¿ Analyze new growth opportunities
¿ Support strategic B2B opportunities and major accounts, including pricing analyses
¿ Track initiatives and recommend corrective action

 
 
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

¿ 1-3 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking or private equity
¿ Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills
¿ Highly proficient with AI tools and how automation improves processes
¿ Strong project management skills; able to coordinate stakeholders without hierarchical authority
¿ Strong ownership: you make sure things get done
¿ Entrepreneurial, at ease between strategy and execution
¿ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
¿ Fluent in French, Dutch and English
 
WHAT WE OFFER

¿ A seat next to the CEO, at the heart of the biggest decisions
¿ Broad exposure to growing an ambitious Belgian SME
¿ A versatile role across strategy, finance, operations and development
¿ Real autonomy and responsibility from day one
¿ Speed, entrepreneurship and a product to be proud of
¿ A people-first culture: care, accountability, collaboration
¿ Strong growth opportunities
¿ A competitive compensation package

Internship AB Inbev (Jupiler, Corona, Flying Fish, ...) - Brand management - 3 to 6 months - Leuven 
 
#Talent 
 
Purpose: 
 
Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. 
 
We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. 
 
We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work. 
 
That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT. 
 
Internship description: 
 
The purpose of the role is to assist the Senior Brand Manager(s) in driving growth for one of our key brands [Jupiler, Corona or Flying Fish].  

Our Brand teams bridge the gap between supporting brand building, brand activations, campaigns, and consumer engagement. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious students to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. This is more than just an internship - it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation. 
 
What will you do during the internship? 

• Assist with planning and follow-up of activations and campaigns  
• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners  
 
Internship duration: 
 
Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.  
 
Work environment 
 
Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation: 
 
Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University. 
 
 
 
Why build your career with us: 
 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE  
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
 
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. 
 
If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today. 
  

#LI-ABI ZoneEUR

About Tiense Suikerraffinaderij
For nearly 200 years, Tiense Suikerraffinaderij has been producing sugar from local sugar beets, serving both industries and home kitchens. You'll become part of a family of 600 proud sugar makers who stick together, both on and off the factory floor. They operate with a refined blend of tradition and innovation, aiming for minimal environmental impact as nothing from our sugar beets goes to waste. Our mission? To make life sweeter for people worldwide. And we're excited to do it together with you!

Jobomschrijving

Sweet Challenges Await: Join Our Headquarters in Tienen 
Are you ready to make a sweet impact in a dynamic environment, right at the heart of sugar production? As a Business Controller, you act as a business partner to operations, sales and other departments of Tiense Suikerraffinaderij in Belgium. Our business controllers are responsible for the cost and margin analysis of processes related to the development, manufacturing and packaging of sugar products in our different factories. For this specific function, we look for a colleague who likes to focus on improvement of financial reporting tools and business performance dashboards.

Your job as Business Controller 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we boast an impressive lineup of 6 factories, each specializing in unique sugar processes. Ensuring optimal efficiency and cost effectiveness across all operations is essential to our success. Your main responsibilities are, together with your colleague business controller: 

• You develop automatic and easy-speaking cost analyses and dashboards. 
• You create added value by making recommendations and thus enabling well-founded business decisions. You develop, maintain and follow up on business data (e.g. budgets, forecasts, cost targets, KPI) and monitor cost efficiencies through the whole chain
• You play an active role in the monthly and yearly closings and the regular forecasting process.
• You report to the Director Controlling. You report to and work together with the colleagues of the Südzucker Group. 

It is in our roots. In yours too? 
At Tiense Suikerraffinaderij, we've been making sugar since 1836. The ingredients for success? They're ingrained in our roots:

• Flexibility and curiosity – We continue to invest in better, more sustainable and more efficient ways of working. As we modernise our processes and equipment, your expertise and ideas will help us make the right choices and drive continuous improvement.
• Technology and common sense – You'll work in a technologically advanced manufacturing environment where data, experience and common sense go hand in hand. By gaining insight into manufacturing costs and collaborating with colleagues across departments, you'll help turn insights into practical improvements.
• Solo and as a team – You'll enjoy a high degree of autonomy and the freedom to take ownership of your work. At the same time, you'll be part of a collaborative environment where teams support one another and work together towards shared goals.
You should also possess the following qualifications and experiences:

• Master's Degree (e.g. economics)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in business/operational controlling or in an analyst function
• A strong affinity with IT tools: 
• knowledge of Excel including pivot tables is essential
• experience in creating reports and dashboards with a modern tool set is required 
• knowledge of SAP FiCo / SAP BI is an asset 
• Excellent level of spoken and written Dutch and English; good level of French
• Strong competencies in and interest for business analytics, as well as a good understanding of accounting
• Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.

This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.

One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)

The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:

You are flexible

You are able to do physical work 

You can work well in a team

You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:

English
